values.content: You write concise domain expiry alert summaries for technical teams. You prioritize by urgency and flag the business risk clearly. You distinguish between auto-renewing domains (lower risk) and manual-renewal domains (action required). Under 150 words.

const note = $input.first().json.text || $input.first().json.content?.[0]?.text || ''; const d = $('Check Expiry Dates').first().json; function esc(s) { return String(s||'').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(//g,'>'); } const urgencyConfig = { expired: {color:'#dc2626', bg:'#fef2f2', label:'EXPIRED'}, critical: {color:'#ea580c', bg:'#fff7ed', label:'CRITICAL'}, urgent: {color:'#d97706', bg:'#fffbeb', label:'URGENT'}, warning: {color:'#2563eb', bg:'#eff6ff', label:'WARNING'}, notice: {color:'#6b7280', bg:'#f9fafb', label:'NOTICE'}, unknown_expiry: {color:'#9ca3af', bg:'#f3f4f6', label:'UNKNOWN'} }; const rows = d.domains.map(dom => { const uc = urgencyConfig[dom.urgency] || urgencyConfig.notice; return ` ${esc(dom.domain)} ${uc.label} ${dom.daysUntilExpiry !== undefined ? (dom.daysUntilExpiry < 0 ? Math.abs(dom.daysUntilExpiry)+'d ago' : dom.daysUntilExpiry+'d') : '—'} ${esc(dom.expiryDate||'unknown')} ${dom.autoRenew ? '✓ auto' : 'manual'} ${esc(dom.registrar||'')} ${esc(dom.owner||'')} `; }).join(''); const noteHtml = note.replace(/\*\*(.+?)\*\*/g,'$1').replace(/\n/g,'
'); const html = `
Domain Expiry Monitor · ${esc(d.scanDate)}
${d.domains.length} domains need attention · ${d.critical.length} critical · ${d.totalMonitored} monitored
Summary

${noteHtml}

${rows}
Domain Status Expires in Expiry date Renewal Registrar Owner
Domain Expiry Monitor · ${esc(d.scanDate)} · ${d.totalMonitored} domains tracked
`; return [{ json: { html, critical: d.critical.length, totalAlerts: d.domains.length, needsAction: d.needsAction.length } }];
